svg.title: Product specific by construction. One profile, bust 35, waist 29.5, hip 38.5 inches, regular fit, against different brands' charts: Kazo Sequin Party Dress, slim cut, size L, high confidence. AND Belted Shirt Dress, regular cut, size M, high. ONLY Puff Sleeve Dress, regular cut, size M, high. W for Woman Tiered Midi, relaxed cut, size S, high. Libas Anarkali Maxi, regular cut, size S, medium. Same body, four different letters, and nothing about other shoppers produced that spread: it is the charts. Advice is never arithmetic: a brand's runs small note and your own reported kept or returned outcomes are shown beside the recommendation, never folded into it. The receipt lists the measurements used with values, the ones skipped marked not given and not estimated either, the brand's chart rows, the ease target split into cut and preference, and what was not used.

section.h2: One profile, five dresses, four different letters.

div.p: A brand's “runs small” note and the kept or returned outcomes you report yourself sit beside the size, never folded into it. On one data point, your judgement beats ours. Nothing about other shoppers produced the spread above: it is the charts.

Every size carries a receipt
measurements used, with values
skipped: not given, not estimated either
the brand's chart rows
ease target: cut + your preference, in inches
